title: Terms of AI usage
intro: Green Media uses AI to draft review replies, captions, Google posts and video text for your business.

sections.heading: What the AI sees
paragraphs: The review or topic, your business details, and what you entered in Preference (brand name, story, audience, hashtags). It never sees your passwords or payment details.

sections.heading: You stay in control
paragraphs: Every draft waits for your approval, except where you turn on automatic posting. You can edit any draft before it goes out, and you're responsible for what you publish.

sections.heading: Accuracy
paragraphs: AI can make mistakes. It's told to use only facts you gave and never invent prices, offers or claims; check drafts before approving. Tell us if something looks wrong and we'll fix the prompt.

sections.heading: Providers
paragraphs: Drafts are written through our AI provider's business API (OpenAI or Anthropic), only to make the draft you asked for.
